customers.evidence: We put our customers and people first

employees.evidence: We will elevate our people practices to ensure our people feel welcomed, valued, and part of the McDonald’s community

dei.evidence: We open our doors to everyone

safety.evidence: are committed to fostering a safe, respectful and inclusive workplace

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice with short headline values (Serve, Inclusion, Integrity, Community, Family). Customers and people lead the framing. Commitments are mostly absolute ('We put...', 'We do...'), though the employee section is hedged as 'will elevate'. Environment, shareholders and innovation are absent. The 'Family' value is not coded.
